rationale: All Epic 12 material trace rows are FULL after the protected 2026-08-17 evidence refresh. The former P0 blockers for protected production performance/no-fan-out, protected jobs/service-only posture, live visibility migration, and protected Storage policy are now closed. Recovered Vercel request/function/external telemetry now corroborates the protected production route lane: 41/41 unique-UAs all 200, 21 MISS + 20 HIT, 21 /api/venues invocations all dub1/200, observed cold p95 1827 ms (n=3), internal request-duration p95 2358 ms for origin MISS and 56 ms for HIT, and 63 canonical external dependencies all Supabase host. Story 12.12 Storage now has both static protected catalog evidence and bounded dynamic smoke evidence for service-role create-only upload, public read, browser write denial, and cleanup. The former P1 gaps for concurrent visibility/cache behavior and future-date exact-response stability are also closed. The PASS does not claim 20 classified Vercel cold starts; the strict classified-cold sample is n=3, and external 21 x 3 attribution is inferred because provider path dimension is unsupported.

Canonical external metric recovered 63 total dependencies, all Supabase host, origin route /api/venues, dub1, 200; path dimension is unsupported, so 21 x 3 attribution is an explicit inference corroborated by code, Supabase sample evidence, and exact pg_stat delta.

Legacy aggregate telemetry still times out; this no longer blocks the trace gate because exact-window request/function telemetry, canonical external telemetry, source contracts, and live SQL delta cover the route-performance/no-fan-out lane.
